Перейдите в каталог `~/pool-dumpxml-xpath`.

:::{#exr-lab-libvirt-storage-pools-pool-dumpxml-xpath}
#### XML и XPath storage pool

Сохраните XML и результаты XPath:

```bash
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-dumpxml lab-pool > lab-pool.xml
xmllint --xpath 'string(/pool/name)' lab-pool.xml > xpath-name.txt
xmllint --xpath 'string(/pool/@type)' lab-pool.xml > xpath-type.txt
xmllint --xpath 'string(/pool/target/path)' lab-pool.xml > xpath-target-path.txt
```
:::
